title: Galata Tower
summary: The Galata Tower stands in the Galata district of Beyoglu, Istanbul. Turkish culture-ministry pages say the present tower was rebuilt by the Genoese in 1348-49 and named Christea Turris, the Tower of Christ, after an earlier tower attributed to Justinian. The Ministry of Culture and Tourism reopened it as a museum on 6 October 2020.

uncertainty.note: The culture portal and the museum page give 1348-49; the AKM page gives 1348. End is the present.

as_recorded.value: 1348 - 49 (the present tower was rebuilt by the Genoese)
In 1348, the Genoese built a new tower of rock on the same site and named it the "Tower of Christ."
